projects.title: 👽 Classified Files

moneyScheduler.name: MoneyScheduler
moneyScheduler.description: Mobile app to track income, expenses, and budgeting habits.
moneyScheduler.details: Android project built with Kotlin and Firebase for personal finance control. It includes transaction tracking, category-based organization, and a clean interface to better understand spending patterns and support day-to-day saving decisions.

cartelera.name: Cartelera
cartelera.description: Online movie billboard with dynamic content.
cartelera.details: Kotlin Android app that consumes a REST API to display current movie listings and related details. The project focuses on external data integration, smooth screen navigation, and clear information layout for end users.

panaderia.name: Panaderia
panaderia.description: Mobile app for daily bakery operations.
panaderia.details: Kotlin mobile project aimed at digitizing basic bakery workflows such as product organization and daily task handling. It was designed to practice app architecture and usability in a realistic small-business scenario.

gonorte.name: Gonorte
gonorte.description: Personal training website focused on biomechanics and online plans.
gonorte.details: React-based website to present training services, plans, testimonials, and contact channels for a personal training brand. It includes structured route-based pages and a conversion-oriented visual approach, prepared for GitHub Pages deployment.

gestionDelOlivar.name: Olive Grove Management
gestionDelOlivar.description: Final degree project for olive farm management and analytics.
gestionDelOlivar.details: Web application developed as a final degree project at the University of Granada. It allows farm management, weather forecast consultation, image-based olive tree counting, and key metric visualization. It combines a React frontend with Firebase and cloud services.

portfolioLuis.name: Luis Portfolio
portfolioLuis.description: Personal portfolio with a space-inspired frontend design.
portfolioLuis.details: First version of my personal portfolio, built with React and Tailwind. It showcases profile, skills, and projects with a strong visual identity, interactive sections, and a clear navigation flow for recruiters and collaborators.

proyectoInformaticaGrafica.name: Proyecto-Informatica-Grafica
proyectoInformaticaGrafica.description: Academic computer graphics project with C++ and OpenGL.
proyectoInformaticaGrafica.details: University project focused on 3D graphics fundamentals using C++ and OpenGL. It covers rendering, transformations, and scene composition to consolidate core computer graphics concepts and low-level visualization programming.

jPerformanceLaunch.name: j-performance-launch
jPerformanceLaunch.description: Modern website for personalized training services.
jPerformanceLaunch.details: Web app built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind for a personal trainer brand. It includes training plan pages, informational sections, contact flows, and reusable components. The project is documented and prepared for GitHub Pages deployment.
